mission:
1. Consolidate Fresh Food Production
After successfully launching the local food production system in 2024, the goal for this year is to strengthen and stabilize operations. Maintain and improve a steady supply of high-quality, fresh, and nutritious products for both residents and visitors, contributing to a resilient and regenerative local food system.

2. Enhance the Visitor Experience through Flowers and Berries
Enrich the sensory and visual experience of the garden by incorporating edible and ornamental flowers, as well as berries such as strawberries and raspberries. These additions not only beautify the space but also invite deeper connection with nature and the rhythms of agricultural life.

3. Build the Main Gathering Structures
Design and construct the core infrastructure that will support the garden as a true gathering place. Shaded seating areas, a small outdoor kitchen or fire pit, and communal resting spots will create a welcoming atmosphere for learning, sharing, and celebrating food and community.
